replies.author: ImRaging
replies.body:
Hey Toby,

uCantTouchThis - Excessive Rudeness: Punished
naitsirk - FastBow and Forcefield: Punished
Nak_SoulCrusher - Suicide Encouragement: Punished
VDX - Inappropriate Cape: Not currently punished. This is because the infraction he should receive is a kick. So, if we are to offline kick him, we don't think that he will get the message and change his cape (which we don't think is fair, since he got no visualised warning). However, when a staff member next sees him (assuming he still has that lovely cape) he will be punished.

Cheers, Raging.
